Use case illustration-story. Revise a finished original Korean Instagram comic page. Deliver ONE portrait page, 4:5 aspect ratio. Preserve the approved reference's beautiful warm brown handdrawn ink, muted bluegray/lavender/peach palette, softly washed simple furniture, airy white backgrounds, rounded upright Korean handwritten lettering and gently irregular balloons. First reference is approved character identities, second is approved previous artwork for illustration quality only. CRUCIAL NEW DIRECTION: characters MUST ACT, not all have identical dot eyes and tiny neutral mouths. Use economical cartoon facial lines BUT visibly different eyebrow angles, eyelids, mouth silhouettes, head angles and ear positions for the emotion assigned to each. Faces big enough to read at phone size. Some faces can use crescent closed eyes, half-lidded eyes, round surprised eyes, open speaking mouths, tense asymmetric mouth, downturned corners. Do not default to the tiny neutral W-shaped animal mouth. No photorealism, human hair or eyelashes, no anatomical mouth/teeth detail, no excessive screaming or meme distortion. Characters remain animal-shaped 2-heads tall chinchillas: Bori BLUEGRAY with MUSTARD scarf; Sujin warm TAUPE gray, narrower face, smaller rounded ears and LAVENDER scarf; Miso broad PEACH chinchilla, outward round ears, NO accessory. Human male boyfriend only as tiny RACCOON chat avatar if needed. Preserve species and silhouettes; expressions variable.
STORY READABILITY: clearly show who sends each message. Conversation in group chat labelled '우리 셋'; private chat labelled '수진 · 개인톡'. Never portray characters physically together when texting from separate homes. Time transitions explicitly shown only where specified. Top to bottom natural reading order. Exact Korean text given below, no omissions, no unintended extra copy. Decorative labels in background are forbidden. Generous margins and 36px-equivalent or larger dialogue type. Keep max 2 scene vignettes/page unless specified, no busy montage. LABEL RULES: cover shows fraction 1/3 only, never '1화', '1부', '01/10' or any slide number. Interior pages no episode/page numbering. Ordinary pages may have small '한술툰' footer. Last page footer only exact '-계속-' (no brand or next-title beside ending). Important: requested emotion change must be clearly visible in rendered face, not just body. Create scene described below.
This is carousel page 1 (this number is production instruction, DO NOT PRINT). Scene:
표지. 식당에서 휴대폰을 든 보리와 수진의 작은 메시지 아바타. 표지는 제목과 1/3 표기를 읽기 쉽게 배치한다.
ACTING, essential:

Visible text below. Labels before colons name the speaker or typographic role and should NOT be printed inside dialogue; use tiny speaker names beside chat avatars when helpful. 표지: 약속 깬 건 남친인데,
왜 내 잘못이야?
수진: 네가 너무 받아 주니까 그렇지.
표기: 1/3
작은 글씨: 한술툰 · 창작 사연
